description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy, within its marketing authorisation, with or without bevacizumab, as an option for treating persistent, recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer in adults whose tumours express PD-L1 with a combined positive score (CPS) of at least 1. Pembrolizumab is recommended within its marketing authorisation and subject to the commercial arrangement available to the NHS, stopped at 2 years of uninterrupted treatment or earlier if the cancer progresses.
